domain: Post-trade financial platform with message routing and B-file classification.

glossary.definition: Workflow authority that sends approval and rejection orders.
Reference file used for message classification and routing.
A static lookup table, versioned quarterly, that maps incoming message type codes to B-file classification categories.

business_rules.rule: Mapping rule tables are loaded at system startup and reloaded automatically when a new version is published, with a maximum propagation delay of 30 seconds.
